validity.recommendation: Existence is solid — do not delete. But this row is very likely NOT segment 'II' of the Zhanaozen-Zhetybay-Aktau trunk at all: it is a separately-named trunk pipeline, MG 'KazGPZ-KS Zhanaozen' (Kazakhstan Gas Processing Plant -> Compressor Station Zhanaozen), which two independent official sources list as its own object, distinct from MG 'Zhanaozen-Zhetybay-Aktau'. Recommend either giving this row its own PipelineName ('KazGPZ-KS Zhanaozen Gas Pipeline') with a cross-reference in OtherEnglishNames/ResearcherNotes to the Zhanaozen-Zhetybay-Aktau family it is jointly maintained with, or at minimum documenting the distinction in ResearcherNotes so the 'II' segment label is not read as a literal continuation of the ZZA trunk route.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: CONFIRMED, independent of GEM/gem.wiki, by two official Kazakh primary sources that both explicitly name 'KazGPZ-KS Zhanaozen' as an existing, currently-maintained trunk gas pipeline: (1) the Mangistau Region Complex Socio-Economic Development Plan for 2021-2025 (Government of Kazakhstan Resolution No. 784, adilet.zan.kz, item 116 of its investment-project table) lists, as one combined capital-repair project: 'Капитальный ремонт 3-х ниток магистрального газопровода "Жанаозен – Жетыбай – Актау" Ду 720 мм, магистрального газопровода "КазГПЗ-КС "Жанаозен" Ду 720 мм, магистрального газопровода "Жанаозен – Жетыбай – Актау" Ду 529/530 мм' (i.e.: 3 pipe strings are being repaired together — a 720mm 'Zhanaozen-Zhetybay-Aktau' line, a SEPARATE 720mm 'KazGPZ-KS Zhanaozen' line, and a 529/530mm 'Zhanaozen-Zhetybay-Aktau' line) — with completion dates and budgeted tenge amounts through Q2 2024, i.e. describing an existing, in-service asset undergoing routine capital maintenance, not a hypothetical or GEM-only entity. (2) Intergaz Tsentralnaya Aziya's (Intergas Central Asia, the QazaqGaz trunk-pipeline subsidiary) own 2023 Annual Report PDF independently and repeatedly names 'МГ "КазГПЗ-КС Жанаозен"' as a distinct operating gas transport system under its Aktau branch (УМГ «Актау») on at least four separate pages: once naming it alongside 'МГ «Жанаозен-Жетыбай-Актау»' as a system whose 'technical condition and safe operation' the company maintains; once listing it by name among the systems УМГ «Актау» operates (МГ «Бейнеу-Шымкент», МГ «Жанаозен-Жетыбай-Актау», МГ «КазГПЗ-КС «Жанаозен», МГ «Бейнеу-Жанаозен» 2 нитка...); and once listing it among systems that received internal-cavity cleaning in 2023 (alongside МГ «Средняя Азия-Центр», «Алматы-Байсерке-Талгар», «Кожасай-КС-12», «Сарыарка»). NOTE ON VERIFIER: url_verifier's automated content-check FAILs on this PDF for every Cyrillic token I tried ('КазГПЗ', 'Интергаз'), including tokens on page 1 — this looks like a font/encoding false-negative on this specific PDF (a Cyrillic analogue of the documented Arabic-ligature failure class), NOT a large-PDF reach problem: I independently downloaded the PDF and ran `pdftotext -layout`, which cleanly extracts 'КазГПЗ-КС Жанаозен'/'КазГПЗ-КС-Жанаозен' at 4 separate locations in the document body. HTTP status is a clean 200 (page is live). CLASSIFICATION: the two sources above independently AGREE that 'KazGPZ-KS Zhanaozen' is a pipeline named and enumerated SEPARATELY from 'Zhanaozen-Zhetybay-Aktau', even though both are jointly maintained by the same Aktau branch and repaired under the same capital project. GEM currently files P5776 under pipeline_name 'Zhanaozen-Zhetybay-Aktau Gas Pipeline' with segment_name 'II Kaz GPP-KS - Zhanaozen' — i.e. treats it as a sub-segment/continuation of the ZZA trunk. The primary evidence instead supports P5776 being the entirety of a DIFFERENT, shorter, separately-named trunk line (KazGPZ-plant to KS-Zhanaozen, i.e. the feeder from the gas-processing plant into the compressor station), not a numbered leg of the Zhanaozen->Zhetybay->Aktau route proper. StartLocation='Kaz GPP' and EndLocation='Uzen' in the sheet match this identity closely: 'Kaz GPP' = КазГПЗ (Kazakhstan Gas Processing Plant, in Zhanaozen since 1973 per KMG's own 50th-anniversary press release, https://www.kmg.kz/ru/press-center/press-releases/kazgpz-50/, verified live); 'Uzen' is the historical/oilfield name for the same locale as the town of Zhanaozen (renamed from Novy Uzen in 1993) that the compressor station 'KS Zhanaozen' sits at, so EndLocation is consistent even though it does not use the town's current name explicitly.

validity.researcher_notes: DUPLICATE CHECK vs P3948 (149.1 km, dia 720mm, 'I', Uzen->Mangistau) — the orchestrator flagged the near-exact arithmetic match 17.8 (P5776) + 60.7 (P5777) + 70.8 (P5783) = 149.3 ~ P3948's 149.1 as a possible aggregate/double-count. Having now identified P5776's true identity (see the classification entry above), this coincidence looks LESS like a double-count of P5776 specifically and more like an artifact of P3948 and P5776 independently sharing the same 720mm diameter: the Mangistau regional plan's item 116 names a 720mm 'Zhanaozen-Zhetybay-Aktau' line (matching P3948's own dia=720/len=149.1 as a single, separately-repaired 720mm string) SEPARATELY from the 720mm 'KazGPZ-KS Zhanaozen' line (matching P5776) — i.e. two DIFFERENT physical pipes that happen to share Du720mm, not one pipe counted twice. If that reading is right, P5776's 17.8 km should NOT be summed into P3948's total, and the 149.3~149.1 match is closer to coincidence than a computation error. This does not resolve whether P5777 (60.7 km, 530mm) and P5783 (70.8 km, 529mm) are correctly kept as two segments of the OTHER (529/530mm) 'Zhanaozen-Zhetybay-Aktau' line the same plan cites, or whether P5784 (70.0 km, Zhetybay->Mangistau, cap 3.6, labeled a 'Zhetybay-Kuryk Branch') shadows P5783 — those are separate open questions for P5777/P5783/P5784's own audits.

By contrast, Intergas Central Asia's own 2023 Annual Report (see classification entry above) repeatedly and directly claims responsibility for 'КазГПЗ-КС Жанаозен' as an asset its Aktau branch (УМГ «Актау») operates and performed capital repair on in 2022-2023 — i.e., self-reported first-party operator attribution from a different company than the one currently on the GEM sheet. GEM's PipelineType='transmission' + 720mm diameter (trunk-scale) both point toward the trunk operator (Intergas), not the distribution company, being the better-supported Operator value here. I am not proposing a fill for the current Operator value given this conflict — leaving it flagged rather than either silently passing it or overwriting it without a research judgment from Update.
